meta.sessionScripts: Past sessions as scripts (ADR 0025, ADR 0028, ADR 0031, ADR 0034): the mock API plays each through the real session engine, with number items at each skill's mastery difficulty, or `aboveMastery` above it as the in-session policy serves a child doing well, into sessions and learning events, and the learner model works out every skill status from them. They are written to give each child the statuses meant here, reviews included; a mastered skill has the evidence of a few sessions behind it, as the learner model asks.

title.en: Tens and ones in numbers to 100
Place numbers to 100 on a number line
Make ten to add, such as 8 + 5 = 8 + 2 + 3
Add a two-digit number and ones
Solve one-step addition and subtraction problems
Use arrays of rows and columns to multiply
Halves and quarters of shapes and amounts
Say the sound for each letter
Blend sounds to read words such as cat and sun
Read common tricky words such as the and was
Spell words such as cat and sun
Ten Frame Café: count the order
Ten Frame Café: fill the tray to 10
Ten Frame Café: make ten to add
Tile Farm: fill the field with arrays
Counts the starting number as the first hop

explanation.en: The first hop goes to the next number, so the number you start on is not counted.
Count each hop once, and stop when the count reaches the second number.

title.en: Goes to the second number instead of moving on by it

explanation.en: Adding 4 means moving on 4 from the first number, not going to 4.
Adding moves forward, towards bigger numbers.

title.en: Counts a fruit twice, or skips one

explanation.en: Touch each fruit once as you count, and say one number for each.

title.en: Gives the part shown instead of the part missing

explanation.en: The tray already has some. Count only how many more make 10.

title.en: Counts the whole tray instead of the fruit added

explanation.en: A full tray is 10. The answer is how many were added to fill it.
One tray makes 10. Add what is left in the other tray.

title.en: Counts the moved fruit in both trays

explanation.en: The fruit that moved is now in the first tray. Count it once.

title.en: Adds the rows and the row length

explanation.en: Each row has the same number of plants. Count every plant, a row at a time.
That is one row. Count the plants in every row.

title.en: Counts the rows instead of the plants

explanation.en: That is how many rows there are. Now count the plants in them.

title.en: Counts a row too few or too many

explanation.en: Count each row once, adding one row at a time.
